stem.en: Students recorded only the features of four organisms. Which organism clearly belongs to Kingdom Fungi?

text.en: Microscopic, no true nucleus, rigid cell covering, survives high salt and heat

feedback.en: No true nucleus makes this a prokaryote, so it belongs in Monera.

text.en: One cell, true nucleus, moves with flagella, makes food in light

feedback.en: A single cell with a nucleus that moves and makes food in light belongs in Protista.

text.en: Many cells, clear tissues, backbone, breathes in water early in life

feedback.en: A backbone makes this a vertebrate animal.

text.en: Many cells in threads, cell wall, no chlorophyll, grows on dead matter

feedback.en: Right. A thread-like body with a wall, no chlorophyll and food from dead matter is a fungus.

explanation.en: A fungus has a cell wall, no chlorophyll, and takes its food from dead organic matter. Threads made of many cells fit this exactly.

hints.en: Look for the organism that cannot make food and lives on dead matter.
